* This class overrides the stream-producing methods (such as * {@link RandomGenerator#ints() ints}()) in class {@link RandomGenerator} * to provide {@link Spliterator}-based implmentations that support * potentially parallel execution. * *

To implement a pseudorandom number generator, the programmer needs * only to extend this class and provide implementations for the methods * {@link RandomGenerator#nextInt() nextInt}(), * {@link RandomGenerator#nextLong() nextLong}(), * *

This class is not public; it provides shared code to the public * classes {@link AbstractSplittableGenerator}, and * {@link AbstractArbitrarilyJumpableGenerator}. * * @since 17
